name: RetireOnSol
short_description: Native SOL retirement planner for Seeker
long_description: Plan your SOL accumulation and retirement journey with RetireOnSol V3.5.5 — now a full native app built for Seeker. Two modes — Basic for quick projections, and Advanced for complete retirement planning. GROW tab projects your portfolio with CAGR, Power Law, and S-Curve models plus Monte Carlo simulations. SPEND tab simulates retirement drawdowns with success probability analysis. MONITOR tab tracks your active plan with DCA schedule, funding progress, and wallet balance. LEADERBOARD tab lets you compete with other planners using your Seeker ID (.skr name). Connect via Seed Vault (native MWA), get SOL price alerts and DCA reminders, and protect your data with biometric lock. Supports JitoSOL staking yield and inflation-adjusted returns.
